title: I Once Was Bound, But Now I'm Free

top_liked.author: @kylaluv8453
top_liked.text:
Nothing is more freeing than finally being able to be who you truly are, something many religious beliefs don't allow.

As long as you are not raping, stealing, killing, or abusing, then no one should care what you do or think.
